sentence: The maximum total debt service (TDS) ratio is 42% [S1][S3].
The EXC-100 has five required fields, and a request is complete only when all five are filled in [S1].
Loan number, in the format DMC-YYYY-NNNNN [S1]
Exception type, naming which of the four excepted items applies [S1][S2]
Requested value, such as the ratio, loan-to-value, accepted document or new rate hold end date [S1]
Justification, explaining in plain words why the exception is sensible for the file [S1]
Compensating factors, listing documented strengths that reduce risk and are not already counted in the excepted figure [S1]
A rate hold on a refinance lasts 60 days [S1][S2].
The hold begins on the date Mortgage Operations acknowledges the complete application under PRC-001, and it ends 60 days later [S1].
A rate hold is not an approval, and the borrower gets the held rate only if the mortgage is approved and every condition is met [S5].
A borrower who needs more than 60 days must ask for an extension [S1].
If you give no instruction by the maturity date, your mortgage renews into the open product FX1-O [S1][S3].
The balance renews for the FX1-O term at the FX1-O rate on the rate sheet in force on the maturity date [S1][S2].
Mortgage Operations sends you the new terms in writing on the same business day [S1][S2].
The FX1-O rate is higher than the closed terms, so staying in FX1-O may cost you more [S2].
You can move to a closed term at any time with no penalty, because FX1-O has none [S1][S2].
Underwriting counts self-employed income as the average net income of the last 2 years [S1].
Net income is the income on the notice of assessment after business expenses are deducted, and gross business revenue is never counted [S1].
Add the net income for each of the 2 years, then divide by 2 [S1].
If the most recent year's net income is lower than this average, the lower figure is used [S1].
If the business made a loss in either year, self-employed income may not be counted [S1].
For the SEA-5 product, the borrower must have been in business for at least 2 years before the application [S5].
The lender must give a final response in writing within 30 calendar days of the date the complaint was received [S1].
If the investigation cannot be finished in that time, the Complaints Office must write to the customer before the deadline with the reason and a new date [S1].
A Customer Service Representative may view the status of a file and the contact details needed to answer the customer [S1][S2].
They may not view the full financial documents [S1][S2].
Mortgage Operations signs off the title confirmation from the lawyer [S2].
The FAQ also lists the lawyer's title confirmation among the items Mortgage Operations signs off [S1].
A person may not sign off a condition they supplied themselves [S2].
The 1-year fixed open mortgage, FX1-O, has a contract rate of 6.99% on the rate sheet effective 2026-11-01 [S2].
Because the sources give this rate as of that date, check the current rate sheet for any later change [S1][S2].
Underwriting uses the lower of the purchase price and the appraised value, which is 490,000 [S3]
LTV is the loan amount divided by that value: 400,000 / 490,000 = 81.6% [S1][S2][S3]
Because 81.6% is above the 80% conventional limit, the loan needs mortgage default insurance [S2][S5]
Reducing the loan to 392,000 would give 80.0% LTV and avoid the need for insurance [S1]
